method.pull_requests: GitHub GraphQL, 32 pages of up to 25 PRs ordered by creation; nested review/comment totals reconciled
method.inline_comments: GitHub REST pulls/comments, 19 pages of up to 100 comments, last page 24
method.words: Number of non-whitespace runs in raw API body; includes markup, code and folded details
method.exact_repeats: Same PR and identical trimmed body, at least 150 characters; 155 CHANGES_REQUESTED bodies plus 1047 root inline bodies; excludes replies and conversation comments

limits: Review states are stored submission states, not a list of current blockers.
Dismissed reviews can have had another earlier state.
Deleted or pre-edit comment versions are not recovered.
Only selected records received semantic presentation analysis.
Counts and whitespace words are not model tokens or measured comprehension.
